prompt: Title-case a headline, leaving small words like "of" and "the" lowercase unless they are the first or last word. Complete toTitleCase, then run the tests.
explanation: Lowercasing each word first makes SHOUTED input behave the same as lowercase input and gives the small-word lookup a consistent key. The position test i > 0 && i < words.length - 1 is what keeps the rule from swallowing the first and last words, and it also handles a one-word headline, where index 0 is simultaneously first and last. Capitalising is Character.toUpperCase on charAt(0) glued to substring(1).
hints: Lowercase the whole word before you look it up in SMALL_WORDS, so "OF" and "of" are treated the same.
A word keeps its lowercase form only when it is a small word AND it is neither the first nor the last word of the headline.
Capitalise with Character.toUpperCase(lower.charAt(0)) + lower.substring(1), and build the result with a StringBuilder, adding a space before every word except the first.
